verdict.rationale: Apify is a web-scraping platform, so natural-language extraction is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no feature that turns natural-language instructions into structured data. The cited material covers Actors, SDKs, proxies, scheduling, webhooks, prebuilt Store scrapers and an MCP server for agents to discover Actors, none of which replaces writing selectors with plain-language instructions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors
